answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 20849 Country: India Title: i have frequent nightfalls without any feeling about that.. is that mazi or something else and should i perform ghusl.. Question: as salamu alaykum.. i am 21.. i have frequent nightfalls without any feeling about that.. is that mazi or something else and should i perform ghusl.. Answer ID: 20849 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 643/506/H=1431) If you got wet dream while sleeping during night or day and the stuff exists on your body or cloth, ghusl is wajib though you remember having wet dream or not. In this case this stuff is not madhi (pre-seminal fluid) but semen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
